faq.section.title: FAQ
faq.privacy.a: Files are processed entirely in your browser. Nothing is sent to any server.
faq.who.a: Designed for cyclists whose rides were split into multiple files due to device battery drain or pausing. Merge them into one file to upload to Garmin Connect, Strava, and more.
faq.howto.a: Drop all the files you want to merge (or click to select them), then press "Merge & Download". You can drag to reorder files before merging.
faq.tips.a: Garmin Connect and Strava may reject uploads if duplicate activities already exist (especially Strava). Delete the original split activities before uploading the merged file.
